name: @preflight/core
description: Preflight gate core — provenance lattice, grounding store, verdicts, receipts, shadow mode. Zero runtime deps, zero LLM, zero network.
//build-choice: BUILD CHOICE (Phase 2 walking skeleton, STAFF-ENG): plain `node` running .ts files
directly via native type stripping (default-on since Node 23.6; verified on v24.14.0).
No tsc, no tsx, no ts-node, no node_modules AT ALL: `npm test` works from a clean
checkout with zero installs. Constraint accepted in exchange: erasable-TS syntax only
(no enums, no namespaces, no constructor parameter properties) — which the ported
KICKOFF rules 6+7 (zero runtime deps, zero LLM/network in the gate path) are enforced
by test/enforcement.test.ts, which fails the build if either ever regresses.
